notes.title: Pet Contest! Feature your pet in game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10606530/4b595593dc2b65ae5f561b7ae359f8466813d054.png[/img]

Fam, you've shown us so much love over the years that we wanted to show our appreciation with a very special contest: Your pet can appear in Stars in the Trash! Yes, you heard it right. Select the best photos of your cat, dog, bird, fish, spider, you name it,  and participate! Some pets will be selected at random and others by number of votes.

Moreover, on the occasion of the Steam Next Fest the demo will be available again from today until the end of the contest.

All the details in this FAQ:

[b]How can I participate?[/b]

As simple as uploading a photo of your pet through the form on the page: [url=https://pr.easypromosapp.com/p/977884]Pet Contest Link[/url]  💌

[b]What are the prizes?[/b]

There are 6 prizes divided into two categories:

Category 1: Your pet will be featured in Star in the Trash video game as a NPC (Non-Player Character).

Category 2: A poster of your pet will be featured in Star in the Trash video game.

[b]How are the winners chosen?[/b]

The 1st and 2nd most voted pets win a category 1 prize.
The 3rd and 4th most voted pets win a category 2 prize.

In order to give all pets a chance to appear in the game, one prize from each category will be randomly raffled among all participants.

[b]How often can I vote?[/b]

You can vote once a day.

[b]When is the contest over?[/b]

The promotion will run from 05/25/2024 at 00:00 GMT+1 to 06/23/2024 at 23:59 GMT+1

[b]How can I increase my chances of winning?[/b]

Share with friends so you can get more votes.
If many people add Stars in the Trash to their wishlist we will increase the number of prizes.

[h2]Wishlist Star in the Trash[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1822240/Stars_In_The_Trash/

notes.title: AMA answers
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10606530/2352aa6e04b6c392a15105123245b6a569855b0d.png[/img]

As I promised, here are the answers from AMA (Ask Me Anything). Many thanks to everyone for participating. Thank you for joining us in this adventure. These months are being especially hard and it’s comforting to know that you are here, supporting us. I wish you a great starting of the year.
 
[h1]Soldier of Light[/h1]  

[b]Hello! What is the storyline in your new game? How old is Tika? She's so adorable, we all love her! Happy new year[/b]

Hi. Happy New Year! Tika is 5 years old. Without going into much detail, Stars In The Trash tells a  story about a lazy cat, that leaves the comfort of its home and embarks on a dangerous journey to rescue his best dog friend.


[h1]Cécile Catina[/h1] 

[b]When do you think Stars in the Trash will be released?[/b]

It is still too soon to know it with certainty, but it will arrive at some point in 2019.

[b]How old is Tika? (i know i shouldn't ask the age of a lady)[/b]

Tika is 5 years old (very well kept, by the way).

[b]Will she be in Stars in The trash just like in the Purring Quest?[/b]

Definitely (we could be punished, if not). [Maybe not just like in The Purring Quest, but she can indeed be interacted with in Stars in the trash.]

[b]Will her husband Magnus be?[/b]

We yet do not know how -interactively speaking- but he will be present in the game somehow.

[b]How many of you are working on the project?[/b]

We are a tiny team. Currently there are only 2 people working in the project. Next year, an audio artist -Yevheniy- will join us too, to create the sounds and music.

[b]Are you already planning something else after Stars in the Trash? [/b]

We have some ideas in mind but everything will depend on how well Stars in the Trash goes.

[b]Cat related or not?[/b]
 
There will be cats, but maybe not the way you expected from us... (mysterious music).


[h1]Darcalus[/h1]
  
[b]Would love to have a release date for Stars in the Trash. i would also love to have more wallpapers (they're fantastic!) Thanks for all of the hard work! [/b]

Thank you, Darcalus. Write it down for 2019 in the calendar ;) . Don’t you worry. We have many wallpapers in the planning.


[h1] RafLunarWinter[/h1] 

[b]I have a slight feeling that you guys love cats. Is that true?[/b]

Not at all, they are unfounded rumors. We hate them deeply :P
Jokes aside, it is evident that we feel a very special bond to them.

[h1]Ansgar[/h1] 

[b]I would also like to know -approximately- when "Stars in the Trash" will come out ... I hope you have had a happy Christmas and that you also enjoy the Year’s Eve. I hope you will be very successful; regards ! ! ! ![/b]

Hi, Ansgar. You too! The release date is on 2019, but we’re not able to specify more at this time.


[h1]Fabian[/h1] 

[b]Will your new game be available in the same languages as The purring quest? Will you include any others (For example: German, French, Portuguese)?[/b]

We will try to translate it to as many languages as possible from the day of release. Among them, there will be those you’ve named. 

[b]Have you thought of adding any special theme in the game, for the holidays like Christmas or Halloween? (For instance, the protagonists wearing a Santaclaus hat when playing on Christmas).[/b]

For now, we are focusing on the default game. Depending on the game’s reception, we could add more content, but it all depends on how well it works.

[b]Have you thought about adding a hidden extra in the game, for those of us who have The Purring Quest in our Steam library? (Same way as in “Killing Floor”, when you have the game “Dwarfs!”, sort of a secret DLC is revealed).[/b]

We will include some nods for the players of The Purring Quest. We can not say anything because it would ruin the surprise, but you can count them in. We like to hide a lot of easter eggs.

[b]Will you add Steam trading cards to the game?[/b]

With no doubt.

[b]Will the game carry funny designs of Steam achievement logos? (Example: "Letters formed by animals"?[/b]

It is still not decided, but it’s a good idea. We will do our best.

[b]Will there be a piano mission again, even if it is optional to complete it?[/b]

No. Even though we know that many people enjoyed the piano minigame, it was an authentic nightmare to some people. 

[b]Are the protagonists of the game inspired by real animals or have they been taken from your imagination?[/b]

Almost all of the animals that appear are drawn from imagination to paper by Javier -artistic director and animator of Valhalla Cats-. There will also be some real animals, such as the winners of the contest we will carry out next year and some others.

[b]On what dates have you planned to make the contest for our pets to appear in the game?[/b]

During the second half of 2018.

[b]Could you reveal something about the type of combat of the protagonist cat?[/b]

Sure. In a way, we can say that we’ve abandoned some realism in order to favor the fun. For example, now the protagonist stands on the hind paws to perform the attacks. Currently, we have implemented a prototype of basic (but fun) fight, with 4 combos that also allows us to throw or push enemies away.

[b]Which one turned out to be the most difficult for you: "Compose the music", "The design of the drawings", "The script" or "Take 5 euros from Tika’s wallet"?[/b]

We have not started with the music yet. From the remaining points, perhaps the script is the one that is taking longer for us. Tika doesn’t need no wallet, since she has slaves who fulfill all her desires.

[b]Without revealing any details, does the game take on a social issue of awareness? (Yes or no)[/b]

Yes, we want to transmit a message of awareness.

[b]Approximate date of release of the game?[/b]

2019.

[b]Will the egocentric and slaver (of humans) Tika show up in the game?[/b]
Let's see who is the one brave enough to tell her not to...

[b]Is it true that Tika took you as a slave? She sent me a message saying "Tell my adoptive father to change the sand".[/b]

No, it's not true... (sounds of violent meows). Yes, yes, in the studio we are all servants of our beloved boss Tika.


[h1] Mochi![/h1] 

[b]How big your team?[/b]

We are a tiny team. Currently, it’s formed by only 2 members. In 2018, there will be 3 of us working in the project. 

[b]Why this cat https://twitter.com/valhallacats/status/936318290208714763 looks like on my maine coon cat? (referring to the picture of a cat that visited the studio)[/b]

Well, this question is complicated… It seems that somebody made a long trip without letting you know… He swore us he told you! Anyway, don’t worry. We treated him very well and he met our boss Tika.

[b]What is weather today? (in my location very damp, overcast, dirty and snowy 📷) [/b]

We have a very pleasant weather. Clear skies and 20ºC (68ºF) of temperature at this very moment.

We yet do not know how -interactively speaking- but he will be present in the game somehow.

[b]How many of you are working on the project?[/b]

We are a tiny team. Currently there are only 2 people working in the project. Next year, an audio artist -Yevheniy- will join us too, to create the sounds and music.

[b]Are you already planning something else after Stars in the Trash? [/b]

We have some ideas in mind but everything will depend on how well Stars in the Trash goes.

[b]Cat related or not?[/b]
 
There will be cats, but maybe not the way you expected from us... (mysterious music).


[h1]Darcalus[/h1]
  
[b]Would love to have a release date for Stars in the Trash. i would also love to have more wallpapers (they're fantastic!) Thanks for all of the hard work! [/b]

Thank you, Darcalus. Write it down for 2019 in the calendar ;) . Don’t you worry. We have many wallpapers in the planning.


[h1] RafLunarWinter[/h1] 

[b]I have a slight feeling that you guys love cats. Is that true?[/b]

Not at all, they are unfounded rumors. We hate them deeply :P
Jokes aside, it is evident that we feel a very special bond to them.

[h1]Ansgar[/h1] 

[b]I would also like to know -approximately- when "Stars in the Trash" will come out ... I hope you have had a happy Christmas and that you also enjoy the Year’s Eve. I hope you will be very successful; regards ! ! ! ![/b]

Hi, Ansgar. You too! The release date is on 2019, but we’re not able to specify more at this time.


[h1]Fabian[/h1] 

[b]Will your new game be available in the same languages as The purring quest? Will you include any others (For example: German, French, Portuguese)?[/b]

We will try to translate it to as many languages as possible from the day of release. Among them, there will be those you’ve named. 

[b]Have you thought of adding any special theme in the game, for the holidays like Christmas or Halloween? (For instance, the protagonists wearing a Santaclaus hat when playing on Christmas).[/b]

For now, we are focusing on the default game. Depending on the game’s reception, we could add more content, but it all depends on how well it works.

[b]Have you thought about adding a hidden extra in the game, for those of us who have The Purring Quest in our Steam library? (Same way as in “Killing Floor”, when you have the game “Dwarfs!”, sort of a secret DLC is revealed).[/b]

We will include some nods for the players of The Purring Quest. We can not say anything because it would ruin the surprise, but you can count them in. We like to hide a lot of easter eggs.

[b]Will you add Steam trading cards to the game?[/b]

With no doubt.

[b]Will the game carry funny designs of Steam achievement logos? (Example: "Letters formed by animals"?[/b]

It is still not decided, but it’s a good idea. We will do our best.

[b]Will there be a piano mission again, even if it is optional to complete it?[/b]

No. Even though we know that many people enjoyed the piano minigame, it was an authentic nightmare to some people. 

[b]Are the protagonists of the game inspired by real animals or have they been taken from your imagination?[/b]

Almost all of the animals that appear are drawn from imagination to paper by Javier -artistic director and animator of Valhalla Cats-. There will also be some real animals, such as the winners of the contest we will carry out next year and some others.

[b]On what dates have you planned to make the contest for our pets to appear in the game?[/b]

During the second half of 2018.

[b]Could you reveal something about the type of combat of the protagonist cat?[/b]

Sure. In a way, we can say that we’ve abandoned some realism in order to favor the fun. For example, now the protagonist stands on the hind paws to perform the attacks. Currently, we have implemented a prototype of basic (but fun) fight, with 4 combos that also allows us to throw or push enemies away.

[b]Which one turned out to be the most difficult for you: "Compose the music", "The design of the drawings", "The script" or "Take 5 euros from Tika’s wallet"?[/b]

We have not started with the music yet. From the remaining points, perhaps the script is the one that is taking longer for us. Tika doesn’t need no wallet, since she has slaves who fulfill all her desires.

[b]Without revealing any details, does the game take on a social issue of awareness? (Yes or no)[/b]

Yes, we want to transmit a message of awareness.

[b]Approximate date of release of the game?[/b]

2019.

[b]Will the egocentric and slaver (of humans) Tika show up in the game?[/b]
Let's see who is the one brave enough to tell her not to...

[b]Is it true that Tika took you as a slave? She sent me a message saying "Tell my adoptive father to change the sand".[/b]

No, it's not true... (sounds of violent meows). Yes, yes, in the studio we are all servants of our beloved boss Tika.


[h1] Mochi![/h1] 

[b]How big your team?[/b]

We are a tiny team. Currently, it’s formed by only 2 members. In 2018, there will be 3 of us working in the project. 

[b]Why this cat https://twitter.com/valhallacats/status/936318290208714763 looks like on my maine coon cat? (referring to the picture of a cat that visited the studio)[/b]

Well, this question is complicated… It seems that somebody made a long trip without letting you know… He swore us he told you! Anyway, don’t worry. We treated him very well and he met our boss Tika.

[b]What is weather today? (in my location very damp, overcast, dirty and snowy 📷) [/b]

We have a very pleasant weather. Clear skies and 20ºC (68ºF) of temperature at this very moment.

Today is a very special day and that's why I want to celebrate it with all of you. A year ago our first video game, The Purring Quest saw the light. During this time you have become a big family for me. I have had the great pleasure of talking with many of you, share concerns and even making some friends. 

The road has not been easy, however, knowing that you are there, behind the screen, showing us your support gives us strength to continue this wonderful journey every day. Thanks, thanks and a thousand thanks.

On the occasion of this celebration, I want to reveal you our new project: Stars In the Trash. It is an adventure game with a strong animal message in which there will be no lack of puzzles and platform sections. The graphics are being hand-drawn and animated by the great artist Javier Granados using traditional animation techniques. To give you an idea, only the main character of Stars In The Trash has more animations than all the characters in The Purring Quest together! The backgrounds are being drawn on huge watercolor paper.

We are putting a lot of emphasis on developing a game that it is accesible to everyone, even the less skilled. We want the whole family gathered and enjoying the moving story we want to tell you. 

In addition to the usual channels, we have created a specific facebook page and twitter account so you can be among the first informed about the development progress:

https://www.facebook.com/starsinthetrash/?fref=ts
https://twitter.com/StarsInTheTrash

Stars In The Trash is a major step forward, undoubtedly risky, but we think that it will be worth it. There are still many months left for the release. In the meantime we will work tirelessly to offer you a experience that last in your memory. You're invited to join this exciting journey.

notes.title: Studio situation and plans for the future
notes.notes:
Hi friends, I promised to keep you updated with the studio situation and our plans for the future so here I am.

It has been 6 months since The Purring Quest launch. During this time I have been updating it regularly based on your feedback: Steam achievements have been added, difficulty adjustments have been carried out, French and Russian translations and even a double jump control, much funnier than the original, has been added.

I also want to thank you for making the donation program possible. I will keep you informed of each donation so it will be as transparent as possible.

On the other hand I want to confirm that there is a new video game in pre-production. As I already told you, it won't be continuation of The Purring Quest. The Purring Quest means famous cats, means platforms and many other things that separate it from the video game that we are currently working on.

For this game I want to push the production values in every area. The investment will be big, so, after a lot of thinking, I have chosen the episodic format to make the project possible. Some people may not like it but it is the only option to launch the game with the level of quality I want.

The exact number of chapters will depend on the reception of the first one but at least, at the beginning,it is designed to be a trilogy. Obviously, the game will have a reduced price according to their duration.

Regarding the game I can’t say much at the moment. It is my intention to send a strong message so the story will carry more weight. It will be a 2D adventure with puzzles and a bit of platforms. I almost forgot! It is assumed that there will be cats, It could not be otherwise.

I take this opportunity to tell you that next week The Purring Quest will be 70% off on Steam, It is a good occasion for buying it in case you don't have it yet.

Peace and cats =^.^=

notes.title: If you want to buy the Purring Quest but you really can't afford it, send me an email
notes.notes:
Hello my friends. A lot of you already know about my involvement in social welfares . Proof of that is the program of donations to animal welfares that we will start this week in Valhalla Cats and of which I am very proud. But I wanted to take even a little step ahead.

It has been tough years for all of us, also for me. During the development of the purring Quest I even couldn't afford to buy a new video game, that is why I would like to join the initiative that the creator of pixel Piracy had last year:

[b]If you really want to buy the Purring Quest but you cannot afford the 5.99€ (sale prize), you only have to send me an email until the end of 2015 to valhallacats@gmail.com telling me about your situation briefly and I will be delighted to give it to you as a present[/b].

I know that it is not much but I wish it will be useful for cheering Xmas up a bit to some of you. We are a very small studio so, if in the future you want to collaborate with us buying it, we will be grateful eternally. Every purchase means the whole world for us.

Happy holidays for all!

notes.title: Valhalla Cats Donation Program
notes.notes:
Hi, In Valhalla Cats we are committed to animal social causes. The first donations will go to the following animal welfare groups:

[olist]
[*] Blind Cat Rescue and Sanctuary, Inc.
[*] Milo's Sanctuary, Inc.
[*] Canes y Felinos Temuco
[*] khatucai-asociación protectora de gatitos gaditanos
[*] Protectora de Animales de Maldonado
[*] svpap
[*] Protectora La Bienvenida Ciudad Real
[*] Esperanza Felina
[*] Sos Perros Abandonados En Lora Del Rio
[*] ADAP
[/olist]

For the 3 months following the launch day, a part of the benefits will go to them. After that period another 10 will be chosen and so on.

They will get the first proceeds in January



[img]http://www.valhallacats.com/wp-content/uploads/dona_eng-300x293.png[/img]

PD: We are aware that all the animal welfare groups need the donation and it was difficult for us to choose which to start. A few months ago we uploaded a web form and more than 40 organisations around the world signed up. We will upload the form again once everyone has received a donation. At least 3% of the profits will go to them.
